title: Start here — Builder v0.11 is independent authoring infrastructure
summary: Wire UI Builder v0.11 is a consumer-neutral authoring application. FlyLo/FederationBank/etc. are consumers, not implementation dependencies. The Builder Studio project and the target site project are deliberately separate.
invariants: Do not pull consumer business logic into Builder Studio.
The compiled runtime contract remains WIRE-UI/0.1; authoring-time classes need not ship with a runtime serving an already compiled release.
Use the real Builder/Server/gateway path for acceptance; a static demo page is not the Builder.
